partial_query_write.observation: search_b_tree guards result subtraction by tid<num_queries but unconditional d_results[tid] follows; lanes in a partially active final warp can write beyond logical output.

allocator: Original template kernels unchanged; bounded generic allocator preserves atomic allocation and node address arithmetic. Allocation capacity is configured equally across all models.

signed_ballot_witness.consequence: Lane31 internal-key flag is lost by logical shift; leaf status is broadcast from this lane, so node values can be interpreted as pointers.
signed_ballot_witness.repair: reinterpret UInt32 ballot as Int32 before shift and reinterpret shifted bits back as UInt32.
